facts.fact: Senegal launched its national Géoportail (Géo Sénégal), giving the public official base and thematic geospatial data, with consultation and download services for institutions' maps; the article carries no date, so the site's news date is used.

The Géoportail carries data from at least two public bodies, the Centre de suivi écologique (bushfire areas 2023) and ANSD (school locations 2023); the article carries no date, so the site's news date is used.

note: GEOINNOV Challenge 2025 and the bushfire use case are not stated as reuse of published data actually done, so no reuse fact.
